•  In FY19, we committed to powering our datacenters with 70 percent wind, solar, or hydropower energy 
  
by 2023, and in FY20, we extended that commitment companywide and to 100 percent by 2025. 
•  One method we use to respond to climate-related opportunities is our Sustainability Grants program, which 
  
drives climate-related energy and technology innovation; this program awarded more than $10 million in FY19
